ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportCechyPartii' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportCechyPartii;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportCechyPartii] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @MaxInt int = 2147483647 --Max Int
SELECT @rowVersion AS [@RowVersion] ,( select MIN(TPA_ID) as [@LotId], CASE WHEN sekcja=2 THEN @MaxInt ELSE TPa_CCKNumer END as [@FeatureId], case when sekcja=1 then cast(TPa_Cecha as nvarchar) ELSE CONVERT(nvarchar,DateAdd(d,cast(tpa_dataw as int),convert(datetime,'28-12-1800',105)),101) END as [@Value] from cdn.TwrPartie join cdn.Dostawy on TPa_Id = Dst_TpAID left join cdn.TwrZasoby on Dst_GIDNumer = TwZ_DstNumer left join cdn.Magazyny on TwZ_MagNumer = MAG_GIDNumer AND TwZ_MagTyp = MAG_GIDTyp left join cdn.FrmObiekty on MAG_GIDNumer=FRO_GIDNumer AND MAG_GIDTyp = Fro_GidTyp left join cdn.FrmStruktura on FRS_ID=FRO_FRMID left join cdn.PicoKonfig on PcK_CentrumID = FrS_ID left join cdn.picostanowiska on PSa_PcKID = pck_picoid and PSa_Id = @PointOfSaleId cross apply(select 1 as sekcja union all select 2) a where TPa_TwrNumer in (select TwrGidNumer from CDN.POS_TwrDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0)) AND (psa_id is not null or TwZ_Ilosc is null) AND (sekcja = 1 AND TPa_Cecha<>'' OR sekcja = 2 AND TPa_DataW >0) group by TPa_TwrNumer,TPa_DataW,TPa_Cecha,TPa_Ean,TpA_CCKNumer,sekcja for xml path('Value'), type) for xml path('LotFeatureValues') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportCechyPartii TO CDNRaport
